title: SBI Bank of Mahrashtra SimplySAVE credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The SBI Bank of Maharashtra SimplySave credit card is an entry-level card that provides rewards on everyday purchases like groceries, dining, and utilities, ideal for those seeking basic rewards with minimal fees.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
